analysis.purpose: Tests a type-1 spatial object's contact with another object using position bounds and an XZ sphere/segment intersection. Writes a normal and negative relative-vector projection, returning 0/1 on the built-in path. Other types delegate through a runtime callback. Velocity and collision terminology remain geometric interpretations.
analysis.observed_abi: O32: a0 and a1 are object pointers, a2 is a writable contact prefix. Returns a 32-bit status in v0; delegated results are not necessarily boolean. Frame size is 0xD0. Recovered GLSpatialBase, GLSpatialSphere, GLSpatialDispatch and GLSpatialContact definitions retain unknown fields by offset.

calls.observed_abi: a0/a1/a2 point to three position vectors; a3 carries the summed f32 radius bits; the fifth argument at sp+0x10 points to the output vector. Tests v0 for nonzero.
f12 receives the relative vector's squared length. Result is ignored; this caller does not establish a void return.
a0 points to the position-difference vector at sp+0xB8. Inspected callee normalizes in place and returns an integer status; caller ignores it.
Loads callback from dispatch+0xC. a0 is arg1 plus the signed halfword adjustment at dispatch+0x8; a1=arg0, a2=arg2. Propagates v0.
